subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Intensive
solution: The correct answer is **"Superficial."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Intensive"** means involving a lot of effort or activity, or very thorough or detailed. (जिसमें सीमित समय में काफ़ी अधिक कार्य या सावधानी की अपेक्षा हो; गहन, प्रबलित) • **Example**: *We're in the midst of **intensive**__ negotiations.* • **"Superficial,"** on the other hand, means shallow or lacking depth, or only concerned with surface appearances. (जिसे गहराई से या पूर्णता में न जाना या सोचा गया हो; छिछला, उथला) __ • **Example**: *He's fun to be with, but he's very **superficial**__.* • Therefore, **Superficial** is the antonym of **Intensive**. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Real (Option 1)** means genuine or authentic. (असली, वास्‍तविक, काल्‍पनिक नहीं) • **Dare (Option 2) **means to have the courage to do something. (साहस करना) • **Fierce (Option 3)** means aggressive or intense. (क्रुद्घ, आक्रामक और डरावना; बर्बर) 30:T631, Here, the correct part is **"to an range of health problems."**
